beats.label: S1 · Project Butterfly
beats.text: Fresh out of hospital, Chris is press-ganged into Amanda Waller's black-ops squad Project Butterfly, joining handler Clemson Murn, agents Harcourt and Economos, and rookie Leota Adebayo.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces the team that becomes the 11th Street Kids and the Waller apparatus Chris is chained to.

beats.label: S1 · Waller's planted daughter
beats.text: Waller privately orders Adebayo — her own daughter, planted on the team — to hide a forged diary in Chris's trailer that will later be used to frame him.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets up the betrayal that fractures the team and Adebayo's eventual public exposure of Waller.

beats.label: S1 · The targets are aliens
beats.text: The team's first target, Senator Goff, is revealed to be a Butterfly — a parasitic alien piloting a human host. Thousands more have quietly infiltrated Earth's elite.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Reframes the whole mission from political hit-squad to secret alien invasion, the stakes of the season.

beats.label: S1 · Murn is a defector
beats.text: Adebayo discovers that handler Murn is himself a Butterfly — a lone dissenter against his own species' invasion; Harcourt and Economos agree to hide this from Waller.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The moment the team stops working for Waller and starts working for each other.

beats.label: S1 · Chris framed as a killer
beats.text: Adebayo plants the diary; possessed police use it to publicly brand Chris a serial killer, and his supremacist father Auggie leads his Aryan Empire out to hunt him down.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Turns Chris into a fugitive and forces the final confrontation with Auggie.

beats.label: S1 · Chris kills his father
beats.text: Cornered by his suited father, Chris shoots Auggie dead — ending the man who trained him to kill and once made him accidentally shoot his own brother as a child.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Auggie is the wound at the centre of Chris; his death defines Chris's emotional state going into season 2.

beats.label: S1 · Cow dies, Waller exposed
beats.text: The team destroys the Butterflies' food source and starves the invasion; Adebayo then leaks Waller's black-ops program to the press, clearing Chris's name publicly.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Ends the Butterfly plot and legally frees Chris, while breaking Waller's grip on the team.

cliffhanger.text: The invasion is over and Chris's name is clear, but he goes home alone with only Eagly and the last living Butterfly in a jar — having just killed his father, still hallucinating him standing in the room.
questions: Now that Waller's black ops are burned publicly, what happens to A.R.G.U.S. and the team it ran?
Can Chris live with killing Auggie, or will his father keep dictating him from inside his own head?
He helped save the world in secret — does he ever get to become the hero he keeps pretending to be?

characters.name: Chris Smith / Peacemaker
characters.line: The vainglorious mercenary who kills for peace, publicly cleared but privately hollowed out by having shot his own father.

characters.name: Leota Adebayo
characters.line: The rookie who was planted on the team by her mother Waller, betrayed Chris, then chose him over her and blew the whole program open.

characters.name: Emilia Harcourt
characters.line: The closed-off A.R.G.U.S. field agent now leading the team after Murn's death, quietly softening toward Chris but keeping him at arm's length.

characters.name: Adrian Chase / Vigilante
characters.line: Chris's masked best friend, a diner employee who kills prolifically and is uncomplicatedly devoted to him.

characters.name: John Economos
characters.line: The team's tech operator who framed Auggie for Chris's kills and grew from Waller's toady into one of Chris's real friends.

characters.name: Auggie Smith / White Dragon
characters.line: Chris's late father: an Aryan Empire leader who trained Chris to be a killing machine and is now dead by Chris's hand.

characters.name: Amanda Waller
characters.line: The A.R.G.U.S. director who ran Project Butterfly off the books and was just publicly outed by her own daughter.

characters.name: Eagly
characters.line: Chris's bald eagle: genuine friend, lethal weapon, and the only living thing he has never disappointed.

beats.label: S2 · Nobody wants Peacemaker
beats.text: Six months on, the Justice Gang has refused Chris, Waller's fallout has blacklisted Harcourt, and A.R.G.U.S.'s new director Rick Flag Sr. is quietly hunting the man who killed his son.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes Chris's civilian dead-end and the season's antagonist, whose grievance drives every A.R.G.U.S. move.

beats.label: S2 · A door to another life
beats.text: In his storage room's Quantum Unfolding Chamber, Chris finds a door to a parallel Earth where Auggie is a beloved superhero and his dead brother Keith is alive.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The QUC portal is the season's engine; it also gives Chris the family he lost and the temptation to abandon this life for it.

beats.label: S2 · Peacemaker-2 dies
beats.text: His alternate self attacks him in the QUC and dies in his arms; Chris and Adrian bury the body while Chris keeps slipping back to the alt-world he never had.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Puts a corpse in play A.R.G.U.S. can chase and locks Chris into the alt-world obsession that isolates him from the team.

beats.label: S2 · A.R.G.U.S. comes for the portal
beats.text: Flag Sr. sends a strike team to seize the QUC; Economos tips Chris off, Eagly savages the agents, and Chris moves the portal to a remote cabin in Settlers' Hill.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Flag now knows the portal exists and wants it, setting up the season's endgame trade.

beats.label: S2 · Harcourt turns him in
beats.text: Flag offers Harcourt her career back to lure Chris out; she does it and lets him be beaten in custody, then can't stomach it and quietly gets him bailed out.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The moment their relationship is honest — she chose him over her career, which is what makes their season-end coupling land.

beats.label: S2 · Nazi Earth
beats.text: The Kids chase Chris through the portal and discover the alt-world is a white-supremacist utopia; Adrian kills Auggie-2, Chris spares a wounded Keith, and they collapse the door behind them.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Ends the alt-world temptation for good and lets Chris finally reject the fantasy of Auggie as a good father.

beats.label: S2 · Checkmate, then Salvation
beats.text: A.R.G.U.S. weaponises the portal into a metahuman prison dimension called Salvation. The Kids form their own agency Checkmate — and then Flag Sr. abducts Chris and strands him inside it.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The two things that define season 3's opening state: the team Chris finally has, and the cage he is finally in.

cliffhanger.text: One week into finally dating Harcourt and launching Checkmate with his chosen family, Chris is snatched by Rick Flag Sr. and dumped into Salvation — a dimension A.R.G.U.S. built specifically to hold people like him.
questions: Can Checkmate find and reach Chris in Salvation, or is he stranded there indefinitely?
What does A.R.G.U.S. do now that Flag Sr. controls an entire dimension full of metahuman prisoners?
Does Harcourt fight for the relationship she finally committed to, or does losing him a week in break her?

characters.name: Chris Smith / Peacemaker
characters.line: Just finally in a real life — girlfriend, chosen family, a job of his own — and now trapped alone in the Salvation prison dimension.

characters.name: Emilia Harcourt
characters.line: Quit A.R.G.U.S. and openly committed to Chris one week before Flag took him; a founding partner of Checkmate.

characters.name: Leota Adebayo
characters.line: Chris's closest friend and moral compass, now co-running Checkmate and the person most likely to organise a rescue.

characters.name: Adrian Chase / Vigilante
characters.line: Killed Auggie-2 without hesitation to protect Chris; still uncomplicatedly devoted and lives at Chris's side.

characters.name: Rick Flag Sr.
characters.line: A.R.G.U.S. director who wanted Chris dead for killing his son, took the portal from him, and has now buried him alive in Salvation.

characters.name: Sasha Bordeaux
characters.line: Senior A.R.G.U.S. agent who quit in disgust over the Salvation prison plan and defected to co-found Checkmate.

characters.name: John Economos
characters.line: Broke his A.R.G.U.S. cover to warn Chris about the raid; a founding member of Checkmate.

characters.name: Judomaster
characters.line: The S1 antagonist, freed and turned by the Kids; helped rescue Adebayo from the alt-world and now works for Checkmate.

characters.name: Eagly
characters.line: Still Chris's bald eagle — now revealed as a 'Prime Eagle' able to summon a swarm, and currently with the Kids while Chris is gone.
